sents.t: Carlos and Ana’s wedding is in two weeks, and Carlos asked me to be one of his groomsmen.
I was very honored, but I had a problem: I didn’t have a suit.
Lily came with me to the department store at Riverside Mall.
“You should get navy blue,” she said.
The first jacket was too big.
The second jacket was too small.
The pants were long enough, but a tailor had to make them a little shorter.
“They’ll be ready on Thursday,” the tailor said.
The suit was three hundred dollars, but it was on sale.
“Carlos said all the groomsmen should wear yellow ties, because yellow is Ana’s favorite color,” I told her.
Then we had to find a wedding gift.
Carlos and Ana have a wedding registry online, a list of gifts they want.
I bought them a coffee machine.
When I tried on everything at home, Rosa clapped.
